nights.title: Altın Gün
nights.name: Altın Gün
nights.extract: Altın Gün is a Dutch psychedelic rock band from Amsterdam, formed in 2016. Founded by bassist Jasper Verhulst, the band's vocalist Erdinç Ecevit Yıldız is of Turkish ethnicity while the other four members are Dutch.

nights.title: Aşkın Nur Yengi
nights.name: Aşkın Nur Yengi
nights.extract:
Aşkın Nur Yengi is a Turkish singer, composer, and actress.
She started working as a backing vocalist for Sezen Aksu and with Aksu's help, released her first studio album in 1990. With her debut album Sevgiliye in 1990, she became one of the most successful Turkish singers of the '90s.

nights.title: Simge
nights.name: Simge
nights.extract: Simge Sağın, known mononymously as Simge, is a Turkish singer. From early 2010s, she started to make Turkish pop songs, and with the release of her single "Miş Miş" in 2015 she became one of the most famous artists in Turkey.
